Quick one today. I've been listening to the breathless coverage regarding
Keegan Bradley's 2025 Ryder Cup selections for Team USA and I had a thought: is
making Scottie Scheffler perform better enough to warrant a selection for
Sam Burns?

We know that Burns and Scheffler are close[^1]. Does Scheffler perform better
when they're together?

```{python}
import polars as pl
from lets_plot import *

LetsPlot.setup_html()

def article_theme():
    return theme(
        plot_title=element_text(family="Arial", face="bold", size=33),
        plot_subtitle=element_text(family="Arial", size=26),
        legend_position="top",
        panel_grid_minor="blank",
        panel_grid_major_x="blank",
    )

df = (
    pl.scan_parquet("../../data/ppi-rolling-25.parquet")
    .with_columns(
        event_year=pl.col("teetime").dt.year()
    )
    .filter(pl.col("event_year") > 2022)
    .with_columns(
        has_sam_burns=(
            (pl.col("dg_id") == 19483).sum().over(["event_year", "event_name"]) > 0
        ),
    )
    .filter(pl.col("dg_id") == 18417)
    .with_columns(
        event_year=pl.col("event_year").cast(pl.String),
        has_sam_burns=(
            pl.when(pl.col("has_sam_burns"))
            .then(pl.lit("Yes"))
            .otherwise(pl.lit("No"))
            .cast(pl.Enum(["Yes", "No"]))
        )
    )
    .select("has_sam_burns", "sg_total")
    .collect()
)

violin_plot = (
    ggplot(df, aes("has_sam_burns", "sg_total")) +
    geom_violin(aes(fill="has_sam_burns"), show_half=1, size=0) +
    geom_boxplot(aes(fill="has_sam_burns"), color="white", width=0.1, outlier_alpha=0) +
    geom_sina(aes(color="has_sam_burns"), show_half=-1, seed=42) +
    scale_color_brewer(palette="Set2") +
    scale_fill_brewer(palette="Pastel2") +
    coord_flip() +
    ggsize(1200, 800) +
    labs(
        title="Scottie Scheffler performances",
        subtitle="2022-2025",
        x="Is Sam Burns in the tournament?",
        y="Strokes Gained (Total)",
        color="Is Sam Burns in the tournament?",
        fill="Is Sam Burns in the tournament?"
    ) +
    article_theme()
)
violin_plot
```

Seems like Scheffler is better when Burns isn't around. Kinda. Maybe.
There's a lot of noise here (not like they're apart much!).
Anyways, let's see what Bradley decides.

(Go Europe)
